reviews.review_description: Was a great experience all round.Prompt efficient and friendlyRecommend to all .Very happy with this product and it’s installation

The installation was on a rural property across a number of buildings.  Caillim from Synergyze worked through the detail with me over several weeks.  He conducted a lot of research and came up with a system that met our specific needs.  This included incorporating an existing solar array in one building, locating the battery in another building and designing a system that was grid connected, provided automatic backup and enabled the maximum amount of solar energy for our own use.  We lose power quite often where we are and the ability of the system to switch over seamlessly is great.  It was also necessary to extend our wifi system over 200 metres using point to point transmission and also running new cabling, which Caillim handled.  The technology now in place enables us to add additional solar panels and batteries quite easily so that we could consider going off grid down the road if that becomes preferable.Caillim communicated all steps of the process, was punctual, reliable and completed all work as quoted on time.  We are very happy with the work and would gladly use Synergyze Electrical again.

Caillim was prompt with a quote and provided all the information I requested. He was able to provide a detailed quote with options. He answered all my follow-up questions. Installation was easy, well explained when changes needed to be done. The job was completed and the site left clean and tidy. All went as expected.

Recently installed 10.56KW system (Trina Panels / Sungrow Inverter).– I highly recommend Caillim and Synergyze.  Seamless process from my initial inquiry, the follow-up site visit, receiving and understanding the quote, responding to my queries and ultimately the install.  The installation was performed on the date agreed, everything ahs been very professional, high quality, neat and tidy with no mess left behind.  It’s a pleasure to have worked with Caillim – this level of service (in my experience) is rare.

Super happy with the install of our new system provided by Synergize. Caillim was great on the initial quoting and communication process. Caillim gave us the rundown of pros and cons of different systems/brands. The installation process was seamless and cabling super neat and tidy. The place was left spotless afterwards. If you're looking for a cheapo charlie system this is not your installer. If you are looking for a quality install with good components then I definitely recommend Synergize.

A couple of phone calls and emails set up the install. Caillim arrived on time and the install was efficient and workmanlike. The garage was left clean and tidy and the charger was tested before he left.All round I'm very happy with the job and Caillim's 'can do' attitude.

From the first time my husband & I met Caillim, he was extremely professional & very well informed tradesperson. He was able to communicate with us in a way we could understand & was always available to help us through the design process of our off grid system.We were very happy with the detailed quote & then once the system was installed & up & running, Caillim was continually monitoring our system in the weeks that followed.Caillim was so patient with me , talking me through all the technical side & downloading apps etc so I was able to monitor system from wherever I was.I will definitely have Caillim back for any other electrical work I might need in my home & will in the future have him set up solar in my son’s home. I sincerely recommend you use Caillim if you want your job done right. I am happy for Caillim to give you my phone number if you want to chatHappy solar customers Karen & Rob

I recently had the pleasure of working with Synergyze Electrical for the installation of my solar system, and I must say, I am thoroughly impressed with their level of customer service and the quality of their work. From start to finish, Caillim from Synergyze Electrical was professional, knowledgeable, and courteous, making the entire installation process a breeze.His attention to detail and commitment to ensuring that I was completely satisfied with the installation was truly impressive.He took the time to explain every step of the process, answer all of my questions, and provide me with all the necessary information I needed to make informed decisions about my system. Caillim was always prompt, efficient, and always went above and beyond to ensure that the work was completed to the highest standards.The system that Synergyze Electrical installed is top-notch, providing me with excellent energy efficiency and cost savings. The panels are durable, reliable, and have already begun to pay dividends in terms of lower energy bills. I am extremely pleased with the results and would highly recommend Synergyze Electrical to anyone looking for a reliable and trustworthy electrical contractor.Overall, I can confidently say that Synergyze Electrical is a company that truly cares about its customers and takes great pride in its work. If you're looking for an electrical contractor that provides excellent customer service and high-quality work, look no further than Synergyze Electrical.

Caillim completed the electrical design for my tiny house, as well as the off grid energy and waste system design. He designed and installed the grid solar system, including the batteries, inverter and a full roof of solar panels, and it is working wonderfully.He has a wealth of knowledge in these areas and he was able to offer solutions that would best suit my needs.He is proactive, responsive and diligent in the service he offers. He is professional and friendly, and takes to time to explain things in a way that is easy to understand.I would highly recommend Synergyze!
